The Battle of Baballoq was a military engagement during the Kosovo War in 1998, fought in the village of Baballoq near Deçan, Kosovo, then part of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia.
The battle was part of a series of clashes between the Kosovo Liberation Army (KLA) and forces of the Federal Republic of Yugoslavia, including the Yugoslav Army and Serbian police units.
Due to limited and conflicting sources, the outcome of the battle is generally described as KLA victory.
